objective: Implement the in-memory Cache module (get/set with 60s TTL) matching contract C2 with unit tests covering the hit, miss, and expiry paths

frozen_contracts.spec: Cache: get(key) -> value|None; set(key, value, ttl_seconds) -> None; 60s default TTL; in-memory only

non_goals: Do not touch app/api/** (T01 owns the endpoint)
Do not add persistence or eviction policy beyond TTL (Stage non-goal)
Do not add async primitives — single-process assumption A-1
implementation_constraints: get(key) returns None on both miss and expiry — callers cannot distinguish, per C2
TTL default is 60s per frozen assumption; expiry is checked at get time, not by a timer

deliverables.what: unit tests for hit, miss, and expiry

acceptance_tests.description: set then get returns the stored value (cache hit)
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/test_cache.py::test_hit returns the stored value after set

acceptance_tests.description: get for an unset key returns None (cache miss)
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/test_cache.py::test_miss asserts get('unset') is None

acceptance_tests.description: get after the 60s TTL elapses (clock advanced in test) returns None and the entry is dropped
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/test_cache.py::test_expiry asserts get returns None after ttl

failure_cases.expected_behavior: a test asserts ValueError is raised — inputs are validated, not clamped silently

handoff.notes: record the exact get/set signatures in verified_facts — C2 compliance is diffed at T03
